crossRefs.note: So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:

translations.web: “So is the way of an adulterous woman: She eats and wipes her mouth, and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
translations.bsb: This is the way of an adulteress: She eats and wipes her mouth and says, ‘I have done nothing wrong.’
translations.kjv: Such is the way of an adulterous woman; she eateth, and wipeth her mouth, and saith, I have done no wickedness.
translations.asv: So is the way of an adulterous woman; She eateth, and wipeth her mouth, And saith, I have done no wickedness.
